title: Soldier shot dead and another wounded as gunmen fire on their motorcycle at Crossing Simuay, Sultan Kudarat
summary: Two men on a black motorcycle chased and shot Pvt. Egie Boy Buta, 25, and Pvt. Jay-r Nacin Gregorio, 29, both of the Army's 40th Infantry Battalion, as they rode a Yamaha Aerox from North Cotabato towards Cotabato City, at Crossing Simuay Junction, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, at about 2:50 p.m. on Tuesday, 24 November 2026. Buta died and Gregorio was wounded and in treatment, the Sultan Kudarat police said; one outlet reported both killed. Police arrested 2 suspects in a hot pursuit.
